logged_count_note: These are evaluation records, including repeats, not independent datasets. Historical scores used different split/selection policies and are not directly ranked here.

next_steps.evidence: Prior features treated criteria as whole-document word/character TF-IDF and ICD codes as generic text. ICD strings contain nested lists and dotted codes; generic tokenization separates decimal suffixes. No explicit inclusion/exclusion feature extractor was found in the phase scripts.
next_steps.work: Build separate inclusion/exclusion text views, validated eligibility-burden features, and correctly parsed ICD code sets with parent categories. Keep unsupported clinical-bound extraction out until reviewed.
next_steps.evaluation: Compare each view alone and added to the fixed reason-embedding model, using fold-local vocabulary/scaling and the common grouped CV. Reject a block without repeatable gain.

next_steps.direction: Separate models for reason embeddings and structured metadata
next_steps.evidence: Trees were tested mainly on raw/PCA reason coordinates; tree students and fixed-weight metadata co-training were also tried. The PDF says reason embeddings are randomly rotated, so coordinate splits have no inherent semantic meaning. Drug metadata are missing for a substantial fraction of trials.
next_steps.work: Keep a rotation-tolerant embedding classifier; train regularized linear and shallow tree models on the new structured metadata. Evaluate metadata signal independently before any combination. If useful, test a strongly regularized gate learned from inner-fold predictions and explicit metadata coverage, rather than another global weight sweep.
next_steps.evaluation: Use exact matched embedding-only, metadata-only and combined controls. Fit any gate only within outer-training data. This direction is not a claim that metadata will help.

next_steps.evidence: Powerset models, one classifier-chain recipe, and score-level joint decoders already exist. Repeating their names would not constitute a new architecture.
next_steps.work: Only reopen joint modeling if the persistent-error review shows recurring co-occurrence mistakes. Compare a regularized joint label-set estimator on the new representations with independent heads, retaining an escape route for rare/unseen combinations. Prior semisupervised Gaussian mixtures and sparse prototypes should be controls, not advertised as untried methods.
next_steps.evaluation: Use the unchanged sample-F1 target, per-label diagnostics, and nested decoder selection. Advance based on both common CV pools before validation.

constraints: No deep learning, external trial data, label edits or ID predictors. Read-only review; historical benchmark and model artifacts unchanged.
